**Step 1 — Scene:** Rice with a yellow chicken-and-vegetable curry, a side salad, and a small cup of dressing. Water has no energy; the wrapped object behind the salad is not identifiable as food and is excluded.

**Step 2 — Vessels:** Main plate approximately 26 cm across: **531 cm²**. Salad bowl approximately 20 cm across: **314 cm²**. Dressing cup approximately 4 cm across: **12.6 cm²**.

**Steps 3–6 — Items, coverage, volume, and weight:** Coverage percentages below partition each vessel’s food footprint; overlapping curry components are allocated separate shares to avoid double-counting.

| Visible item | Vessel coverage | Area × average height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked rice | 40% of main plate | 212 × 1.5 = 318 ml | 0.8 g/ml | 255 g |
| Chicken pieces, apparent | 20% of main plate | 106 × 1.0 = 106 ml | 0.95 g/ml | 101 g |
| Curry vegetables | 8% of main plate | 42 × 0.9 = 38 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 23 g |
| Yellow curry sauce | 12% of main plate | 64 × 0.65 = 42 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 42 g |
| Mixed salad leaves | 35% of salad bowl | 110 × 2.0 = 220 ml | 0.15 g/ml | 33 g |
| Tomato, cucumber, and other salad vegetables | 30% of salad bowl | 94 × 1.0 = 94 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 57 g |
| Herb dressing | 100% of cup | 12.6 × 2.0 = 25 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 25 g |

Coverage totals: **80% of the main plate**, **65% of the salad bowl**, and the dressing cup’s full footprint.

**Step 7 — Energy:** Using cooked/as-served energy densities: rice 130, chicken 170, curry vegetables 45, curry sauce 120, leaves 20, salad vegetables 25, and dressing 400 kcal/100 g. This gives approximately **686 kcal**.

**Step 8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **636 g of food**, including dressing, is plausible for this substantial rice-and-curry plate plus salad. The largest uncertainties are the meat identification and the oil content of the sauce and dressing; a reasonable energy range is **550–850 kcal**.
